reply.emotion: rushed and breathless, having too many things to do at once
notes: When modifying a noun, the form changes to 바쁜 (e.g., 바쁜 하루).

senses.definition: Having a lot of things to do or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 요즘 회사 일이 많아서 너무 바쁘다.
examples.translation: I am so busy these days because I have a lot of work at the office.
examples.emotion: stressed and overwhelmed by a heavy workload

senses.definition: Requiring quick action because there is not much time left.

examples.translation: I feel rushed because I do not have much time.
examples.emotion: anxious and hurried as time runs out
